name: Nippon Kodoshi Corporation
summary: Nippon Kodoshi Corporation manufactures and sells separators in Japan and internationally. The company offers separators for low, medium, and high voltage aluminum electrolytic capacitors; conductive polymer solid capacitors; hybrid capacitors; cellulion separators for lithium-ion batteries; and electric double-layer capacitors and lithium-ion capacitors. It also provides post-lithium-ion batteries. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Kochi, Japan.
